title: Owls nest campground

services.name: The Campground
services.desc: The Owl's Nest Campground is a 44 site oasis nestled in the community of Coaldale, Alberta. Once an abandoned relic (well, a field), the campground was purchased and revitalized in 2020 and is now OPEN and welcoming campers for the current camping season! Owl’s Nest Campground is family owned and operated, conveniently located within the town of Coaldale. Coaldale is our home and our preferred destination to live, work and play. We take The campground is pet-friendly and boasts an attached off-leash dog park, bike park and a network of walking/biking pathways suitable for the entire family.
